title: pvAppendSelections
body:
## pvAppendSelections

Combines several selections (vtkSelection), for example ID, block and threshold selections, into one (vtkAppendSelection). With no Expression the inputs are joined with OR; with an Expression such as "(A|B)&!C" the inputs, named by SelectionNames in input order, are combined with | (or), & (and), ^ (xor) and ! (not). InsideOut inverts the result. A selection is not a dataset: connect it to the Selection input of pvExtractSelection, pvPlotSelectionOverTime or pvAnnotateSelection; it cannot be published as geometry.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- When Expression is set, give exactly one name per input; otherwise the native filter fails.
- Inputs should use the same FieldType (all cells or all points); the filter does not check this.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AppendSelections`. Identity: `filters/AppendSelections`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. ParaView: This property indicates the inputs to the AppendSelections filter. Accepted data: selections (vtkSelection). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkSelection"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AppendByUnion` | Allows by default to not append by union, so that an expression can be used. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Expression` | This property specifies the expression which defines the relation between the input selections. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `InsideOut` | When this property is false the selection describes everything that should be extracted. When this is true the selection describes everything that should NOT be extracted. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SelectionColors` | Specify color to use for each input selection. Complete tuples of 3 values. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `SelectionNames` | Specify names to use for each input selection. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAppendSelections",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ]
  }
}
```
